events.text: Martín de Gurrea y Aragóna was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Martín de Gurrea y Aragóna ( 17 May 1525 - 25 April 1581 ) was a Spanish nobleman

events.text: Martín de Gurrea y Aragóna died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Martín de Gurrea y Aragóna ( 17 May 1525 - 25 April 1581 ) was a Spanish nobleman

events.text: He inherited the title of Count of Ribagorza.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He inherited the title of Count of Ribagorza on his fathers death in 1550 .

events.subject: self
events.quote: He also became 4th Duke of Villahermosa in 1558

events.text: He accompanied Philip to Brussels in 1555.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He also became friends with Philip , who he accompanied to England to marry Mary I and to Brussels in 1555 to witness

events.text: In 1557 Martín distinguished himself in the battle of St Quentin.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1557 , Martín distinguished himself in the battle of St Quentin , gaining him royal favour

events.text: He had to leave court to govern his possessions in Aragon after his wifes death in 1560.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he had to leave court to govern his possessions in Aragon after his wifes death in 1560

events.text: Martín remarried around 1542 to Luisa de Borja y Aragón.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Martín remarried around 1542 to Luisa de Borja y Aragón

events.text: The duke married a third time to María Pérez de Pomar in 1566.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The duke married a third time after her death , to María Pérez de Pomar in 1566

events.text: A court in Zamora took rights, rents and castles of the County of Ribagorza out of Martín's hands.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 6 June 1554 a court in Zamora took rights , rents and castles of the County out of Martíns hands

events.text: He passed the County of Ribagorza to his eldest son Juan de Gurrea y Aragón.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 6 May 1565 he passed the County of Ribagorza to his eldest son Juan de Gurrea y Aragón

events.text: He betrothed his eldest son Juan de Gurrea y Aragón to Luisa Pacheco Cabrera.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 6 May 1565 he passed the County of Ribagorza to his eldest son Juan de Gurrea y Aragón , who he also betrothed to Luisa

events.text: The lawsuit to regain control of the County of Ribagorza proved successful.
events.subject: self
events.quote: which eventually proved successful on 18 May 1567

events.text: married Luisa de Borja y Aragón
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1542 married Luisa de Borja y Aragón
